inv.desc_en:
SPECTACULAR EXCLUSIVE COMMERCIAL PREMISES IN MADRID NUEVO NORTE | 160 m² | LARGE DISPLAY WINDOW | 35 m² PRIVATE PATIO

Contact for more information or to arrange a visit with (DANIEL-681-87-20-86)

Invest today in the area that will define the future of Madrid

Spectacular 160 m² commercial premises for rent, located in one of the areas with the greatest business and urban development potential in the capital: Madrid Nuevo Norte.

A unique, modern, and versatile space, ideal for businesses looking to differentiate themselves, project a premium image, and position themselves in a strategic location of enormous growth.

Key Features

160 m² built area

Large glass facade with high visibility from the street

Open-plan, very bright main space

Control of facilities and energy consumption from mobile devices

Current layout with an independent office and a glass-enclosed meeting room

2 full bathrooms, one adapted for people with reduced mobility

Private patio of approximately 35 m²

Installed air conditioning

LED lighting

High ceilings and modern industrial aesthetic

Excellent condition

Direct access from the street

A space with multiple possibilities

Thanks to its configuration and location, it is ideal for:

* Medical or dental clinic
* Physiotherapy or wellness center
* Academy or training center
* Coworking space
* Architecture or engineering studio
* Real estate agency
* Showroom
* Technology center
* Specialized store
* Commercial office open to the public
* Advanced aesthetics center

Madrid Nuevo Norte: the future is already here

Located next to the most important urban development in Spain and one of the largest urban regeneration projects in Europe.

Thousands of new homes, offices, businesses, and services will turn this area into one of the main economic hubs of Madrid over the coming years.

Establish your business where the city's new financial and business center will grow.

Extras

Possibility of renting an independent storage room on the upper floor.

Easy access from the M-30, M-11, A-1, and public transport.

⸻

A different kind of space for businesses that want to stand out.

If you are looking for a strategic location, a modern image, and a space prepared to grow with your company, this is an opportunity that is hard to repeat.
